name: Raffles Doha
positioning: All-suite Raffles hotel inside Katara Towers in Lusail City, with Raffles Butler Service for every suite
best_for: Travelers who want a suite with a dedicated butler
Food lovers interested in Italian dining at ALBA
Families who want a children's programme

facts.text: Raffles Doha is in Lusail City, Qatar.
Every accommodation at Raffles Doha is a suite.
Every suite reservation includes dedicated Raffles Butler Service, which helps with unpacking, garment pressing, dining reservations and transportation arrangements.
Aqua serves Mediterranean cuisine by the pool.
Raffles Spa & Wellness has private Spa Suites.
The hotel has a Little Guests programme of activities for children.
Suites have a room management and multisensory system controlled from an in-suite tablet.
The Urban Signature Suite has an experience shower and a private steam room.
The Gulf Signature Suite has a salon with a library and an art wall.
Katara Hall is the hotel's ballroom, with arched ceilings, Arabesque artistry and panoramic terraces.
Katara Hall's terraces overlook Lusail Marina.
The hotel is close to Place Vendome Mall, Lusail Marina, Lusail Boulevard and Katara Cultural Village.

highlights.text: Raffles Doha is inside Katara Towers, which were inspired by the crossed swords of Qatar.
ALBA serves Italian cuisine inspired by the truffle of northern Italy.
Acoustic is a rooftop venue with panoramic views of the Lusail skyline.
A guided hotel tour runs at 10:00 am with a light morning tea in Acoustic, and at 3:00 pm with a light afternoon tea.
The Royal Suites are a collection of four themed suites.

considerations.text: The hotel is approximately 25 minutes from Hamad International Airport.
The hotel suggests November to April as the ideal time to visit Doha, when the weather is pleasant.
WhataHotel notes a formal atmosphere that may not suit casual travelers.
